Reading 3:9.title: Technology in practice
Reading 3:9.text: Virtual reality allows athletes to practise movements in a simulated environment. Researchers study cognition to understand how physical experience changes the way people perceive information. One downside is that the same technology may also be used in harmful ways.

Reading 3:9.title: Drones beyond the battlefield
Reading 3:9.text: Workers use drone images to assess damage in areas that are difficult to access. Drones can also help locate people who poach endangered animals. A device designed for military use can therefore support civilian rescue work and wildlife protection.
